thread:
alex_k: bringing up Liberta-13B (community fork) with int4 conversion — cheap convert finished but samples look scrambled vs fp16 reference. suspect rotary/key alignment + vocab id mismatch.

maria_r: repro steps?

alex_k: repro command:
```
python tools/convert_model.py --src liberta-13b.safetensors --dst redwood-liberta --quant int4 --vocab-map vocab.json\```
seeded prompt: \"The quick brown fox\"
ref (fp16): \"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog\"
int4 run: \"The quick brown fox??##\" — weird token outputs and some gibberish.

cheng_w: can you paste topk token probs for first 8 tokens? any kv cache WARNs in the logs?

alex_k: small dump: 
```
step0 top5: [(\"The\",0.18),(\"the\",0.12),(\"A\",0.05),(\"\n\",0.03),(\"?\",0.02)]
step1 top5 shifted -> token ids +2 vs fp16 reference
```
looks like tokenizer->model id mapping off by +2 in parts of vocab. also saw this in the embed index alignment check.

jordan_t: did you check rotary/freq metadata? Liberta exporter writes head_dim=64 in header but our loader consumed 32 historically for some forks. that would garble sin/cos + kv shapes.

maria_r: that mismatch will absolutely cause decorrelation between keys and queries. try loader flags to override rotary head dim and mode: `--rotary-head-dim 64` and `--rotary-mode headwise`.

alex_k: tried `--rotary-head-dim=64` -> sampling improved (fewer non-linguistic tokens) but still vocab id mismatches on some subtokens. suspect tokenizer normalization / BOS/EOS id differences.

cheng_w: quick experiment: remap vocab ids with offset -1 and rerun small eval. command:
```
python tools/remap_vocab.py --in vocab.json --offset -1 --out vocab-remap.json\```
result: token-level alignment fixed for majority of common words; perplexity on evalset dropped by ~0.9 (good).

maria_r: so TL;DR two simultaneous problems: 1) rotary head_dim mismatch in metadata -> sin/cos misapply, 2) vocab id offset in community tokenizer -> token index shift. both together explain weird samples.

alex_k: opened a patch in convertors to: autodetect rotary head_dim from state_dict, assert rotary weight shapes, and validate that BOS/EOS/token ids for top tokens match reference mapping before finalizing conversion. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/convertors/pull/292

ci-bot: CI: convertors/pr-292 — tests/convert smoke: PASSED in 2m 34s

jordan_t: please also add an e2e sanity test under `tests/onboard/liberta/` that compares first-8 token ids and top-5 probs vs fp16 baseline (tolerances: topk token identical, probs within 1e-2).

alex_k: will add `tests/onboard/liberta/sanity.py` + small fixtures. plan to include: sample prompts, tokenizer sample mapping check, rotary shape assertion, and a tiny int4 determinism run (seeded). bench numbers: int4 infer ~23ms per token on dev-GPU (p99 warm), fp16 ~31ms -> cost win preserved.

maria_r: perfect. after PR merges we should add a converter log warning that flags mismatched vocab-id histograms vs expected.

acheng_w: also flag for exporters: if tokenizer normalization != utf-8-nfkc or if BOS/EOS ids differ, emit explicit user-facing note.

alex_k: noted; adding checklist to PR desc. will post follow-up with failing sample attachments.

maria_r: thanks for the triage — great catch on the two factors, and nice quick fix :rocket:
